config.source:
SELECT
  f.transaction_date,
  CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', f.transaction_date) AS DATE) AS sales_month,
  f.product_id, f.customer_id, f.store_id, f.quantity,
  f.transaction_channel, f.payment_method,
  f.net_sales_amount, f.gross_sales_amount,
  CASE
    WHEN is_account_group_member('data_admins')
      OR is_account_group_member('data_engineers')
      OR is_account_group_member('executives')
    THEN f.gross_profit_amount ELSE NULL
  END AS gross_profit_amount,
  s.store_name, s.store_city, s.store_type,
  r.sales_region, r.sales_district,
  p.product_name, p.product_brand,
  CASE
    WHEN is_account_group_member('data_admins')
      OR is_account_group_member('data_engineers')
      OR is_account_group_member('executives')
    THEN CONCAT(c.first_name, ' ', c.last_name) ELSE '***MASKED***'
  END AS customer_name,
  CASE
    WHEN is_account_group_member('data_admins')
      OR is_account_group_member('data_engineers')
      OR is_account_group_member('executives')
    THEN c.member_card ELSE '***MASKED***'
  END AS member_card
FROM maven_dev.gold.fact_sales f
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT * FROM maven_dev.gold.dim_store
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY __START_AT DESC NULLS LAST) = 1
) s ON f.store_id = s.store_id
LEFT JOIN maven_dev.gold.dim_region r ON s.region_id = r.region_id
LEFT JOIN maven_dev.gold.dim_product p ON CAST(f.product_id AS BIGINT) = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN maven_dev.gold.dim_customer c ON CAST(f.customer_id AS BIGINT) = c.customer_id
WHERE is_account_group_member('data_admins')
   OR is_account_group_member('data_engineers')
   OR is_account_group_member('executives')
   OR is_account_group_member('data_analysts')
   OR is_account_group_member(CONCAT('region_mgr_', LOWER(REPLACE(r.sales_region, ' ', '_'))))

measures.name: avg_basket
measures.expr: SUM(net_sales_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(customer_id, '|', store_id, '|', CAST(transaction_date AS STRING))), 0)

measures.name: selected_region
measures.expr: CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT sales_region) = 1 THEN MAX(sales_region) ELSE 'All Regions' END

measures.name: selected_store
measures.expr: CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT store_name) = 1 THEN MAX(store_name) ELSE 'All Stores' END

measures.name: selected_product
measures.expr: CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT product_name) = 1 THEN MAX(product_name) ELSE 'All Products' END

SELECT product_name, product_brand, total_net_sales, total_gross_profit, total_quantity_sold FROM maven_dev.gold.top_products_by_revenue ORDER BY total_net_sales DESC LIMIT 10

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', transaction_date) AS sales_month,
         SUM(net_sales_amount) AS monthly_sales
  FROM maven_dev.gold.fact_sales
  GROUP BY 1
) SELECT sales_month,
       monthly_sales,
       (monthly_sales - LAG(monthly_sales) OVER (ORDER BY sales_month))
         / NULLIF(LAG(monthly_sales) OVER (ORDER BY sales_month), 0) * 100 AS growth_pct
FROM monthly ORDER BY sales_month

SELECT
  f.return_date,
  CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', f.return_date) AS DATE) AS return_month,
  f.product_id, f.store_id, f.quantity, f.refund_amount,
  s.store_name, r.sales_region,
  p.product_name, p.product_brand
FROM maven_dev.gold.fact_returns f
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT * FROM maven_dev.gold.dim_store
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY __START_AT DESC NULLS LAST) = 1
) s ON f.store_id = s.store_id
LEFT JOIN maven_dev.gold.dim_region r ON s.region_id = r.region_id
LEFT JOIN maven_dev.gold.dim_product p ON CAST(f.product_id AS BIGINT) = p.product_id
WHERE is_account_group_member('data_admins')
   OR is_account_group_member('data_engineers')
   OR is_account_group_member('executives')
   OR is_account_group_member('data_analysts')
   OR is_account_group_member(CONCAT('region_mgr_', LOWER(REPLACE(r.sales_region, ' ', '_'))))

SELECT
  r.sales_region,
  DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', ret.return_date) AS return_month,
  SUM(ret.quantity) AS returned_qty,
  COALESCE(sm.sold_qty, 0) AS sold_qty,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(sm.sold_qty, 0) = 0 THEN 0.0
       ELSE SUM(ret.quantity) / sm.sold_qty * 100 END AS return_rate_pct
FROM maven_dev.gold.fact_returns ret
JOIN maven_dev.gold.dim_store ds ON ret.store_id = ds.store_id
JOIN maven_dev.gold.dim_region r ON ds.region_id = r.region_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT ds2.region_id AS region_id,
         DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', fs.transaction_date) AS sales_month,
         SUM(fs.quantity) AS sold_qty
  FROM maven_dev.gold.fact_sales fs
  JOIN maven_dev.gold.dim_store ds2 ON fs.store_id = ds2.store_id
  GROUP BY 1, 2
) sm ON sm.region_id = ds.region_id AND sm.sales_month = DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', ret.return_date)
GROUP BY 1, 2, sm.sold_qty
ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, s.store_city, r.sales_region, s.total_net_sales, s.transaction_line_count
FROM maven_dev.gold.sales_by_store s JOIN maven_dev.gold.dim_store d ON s.store_id = d.store_id JOIN maven_dev.gold.dim_region r ON d.region_id = r.region_id
maven_dev.gold.dim_region
maven_dev.gold.dim_customer

WITH cust AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(c.customer_id AS STRING) AS customer_id,
    CASE
      WHEN is_account_group_member('data_admins')
        OR is_account_group_member('data_engineers')
        OR is_account_group_member('executives')
      THEN CONCAT(c.first_name, ' ', c.last_name) ELSE '***MASKED***'
    END AS customer_name,
    CASE
      WHEN is_account_group_member('data_admins')
        OR is_account_group_member('data_engineers')
        OR is_account_group_member('executives')
      THEN c.member_card ELSE '***MASKED***'
    END AS member_card,
    c.customer_city, c.customer_country, c.gender, c.yearly_income,
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', MIN(f.transaction_date)) AS DATE) AS cohort_month,
    SUM(f.net_sales_amount) AS total_spend,
    COUNT(1) AS transaction_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.transaction_date) AS visit_days,
    AVG(f.net_sales_amount) AS avg_transaction_value,
    DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), MAX(f.transaction_date)) AS days_since_last_purchase
  FROM maven_dev.gold.fact_sales f
  JOIN maven_dev.gold.dim_customer c ON CAST(f.customer_id AS BIGINT) = c.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT * FROM maven_dev.gold.dim_store
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY __START_AT DESC NULLS LAST) = 1
  ) s ON f.store_id = s.store_id
  LEFT JOIN maven_dev.gold.dim_region r ON s.region_id = r.region_id
  WHERE is_account_group_member('data_admins')
     OR is_account_group_member('data_engineers')
     OR is_account_group_member('executives')
     OR is_account_group_member('data_analysts')
     OR is_account_group_member(CONCAT('region_mgr_', LOWER(REPLACE(r.sales_region, ' ', '_'))))
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7
)
SELECT *,
  CASE NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY total_spend DESC)
    WHEN 1 THEN '1 - Top 25% (VIP)'
    WHEN 2 THEN '2 - High'
    WHEN 3 THEN '3 - Medium'
    ELSE '4 - Low' END AS value_segment,
  CASE WHEN visit_days = 1 THEN '1 visit (one-time)'
       WHEN visit_days <= 3 THEN '2-3 visits'
       WHEN visit_days <= 6 THEN '4-6 visits'
       ELSE '7+ visits (loyal)' END AS frequency_band
FROM cust

measures.name: repeat_rate
measures.expr: AVG(CASE WHEN visit_days > 1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)

SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', r.return_date) AS return_month,
  p.product_brand,
  SUM(r.refund_amount) AS total_return_value
FROM maven_dev.gold.fact_returns r JOIN maven_dev.gold.dim_product p ON CAST(r.product_id AS BIGINT) = p.product_id GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  o.order_id,
  CAST(o.customer_id AS INT) AS customer_id,
  CAST(o.product_id AS INT) AS product_id,
  CAST(o.quantity AS INT) AS quantity,
  o.order_channel,
  o.order_timestamp,
  DATE_TRUNC('MINUTE', o.order_timestamp) AS order_minute,
  DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', o.order_timestamp) AS order_hour,
  o.gross_sales_amount, o.net_sales_amount,
  p.product_brand, p.product_name
FROM maven_dev.gold.fact_online_orders o
LEFT JOIN maven_dev.gold.dim_product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id

SELECT order_id, customer_id, product_id, quantity, gross_sales_amount, order_timestamp
FROM maven_dev.gold.fact_online_orders
WHERE DATE(order_timestamp) = (SELECT MAX(DATE(order_timestamp)) FROM maven_dev.gold.fact_online_orders)

SELECT `timestamp` AS event_time,
       CAST(`timestamp` AS DATE) AS event_date,
       level, event_type,
       origin.pipeline_name AS pipeline_name,
       origin.flow_name AS flow_name,
       origin.update_id AS update_id,
       message
FROM maven_dev.ops.silver_pipeline_event_log

WITH t AS (
  SELECT 'fact_sales' AS table_name, MAX(_ingested_at) AS last_ingested_at, COUNT(1) AS row_count FROM maven_dev.gold.fact_sales
  UNION ALL SELECT 'fact_returns', MAX(_ingested_at), COUNT(1) FROM maven_dev.gold.fact_returns
  UNION ALL SELECT 'fact_online_orders', MAX(_ingested_at), COUNT(1) FROM maven_dev.gold.fact_online_orders
  UNION ALL SELECT 'dim_customer', MAX(_ingested_at), COUNT(1) FROM maven_dev.gold.dim_customer
  UNION ALL SELECT 'dim_product', MAX(_ingested_at), COUNT(1) FROM maven_dev.gold.dim_product
  UNION ALL SELECT 'dim_store', MAX(_ingested_at), COUNT(1) FROM maven_dev.gold.dim_store
  UNION ALL SELECT 'dim_region', MAX(_ingested_at), COUNT(1) FROM maven_dev.gold.dim_region
)
SELECT *, TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, last_ingested_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()) AS hours_since_refresh,
       CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, last_ingested_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()) <= 24 THEN 'Fresh (<24h)'
            WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, last_ingested_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()) <= 72 THEN 'Aging (24-72h)'
            ELSE 'Stale (>72h)' END AS freshness_status
FROM t

WITH store AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, s.store_city, r.sales_region
  FROM (SELECT * FROM maven_dev.gold.dim_store
        QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY __START_AT DESC NULLS LAST) = 1) s
  LEFT JOIN maven_dev.gold.dim_region r ON s.region_id = r.region_id
), sales AS (
  SELECT store_id, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', transaction_date) AS DATE) AS month,
         SUM(net_sales_amount) AS net_sales, SUM(gross_profit_amount) AS gross_profit,
         SUM(quantity) AS units_sold, CAST(0 AS DOUBLE) AS refund_amount, 0L AS units_returned
  FROM maven_dev.gold.fact_sales GROUP BY 1, 2
), rets AS (
  SELECT store_id, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', return_date) AS DATE) AS month,
         CAST(0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(0 AS DOUBLE), 0L, SUM(refund_amount), CAST(SUM(quantity) AS BIGINT)
  FROM maven_dev.gold.fact_returns GROUP BY 1, 2
), u AS (SELECT * FROM sales UNION ALL SELECT * FROM rets)
SELECT st.sales_region, st.store_name, st.store_city, u.*
FROM u JOIN store st ON u.store_id = st.store_id
WHERE is_account_group_member('data_admins')
   OR is_account_group_member('data_engineers')
   OR is_account_group_member('executives')
   OR is_account_group_member('data_analysts')
   OR is_account_group_member(CONCAT('region_mgr_', LOWER(REPLACE(st.sales_region, ' ', '_'))))

WITH s AS (
  SELECT CAST(product_id AS BIGINT) AS pid, SUM(quantity) AS sold_qty
  FROM maven_dev.gold.fact_sales GROUP BY 1
), r AS (
  SELECT CAST(product_id AS BIGINT) AS pid, SUM(quantity) AS returned_qty, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount
  FROM maven_dev.gold.fact_returns GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT p.product_name, p.product_brand,
       COALESCE(s.sold_qty, 0) AS sold_qty, r.returned_qty, r.refund_amount
FROM r
JOIN maven_dev.gold.dim_product p ON r.pid = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN s ON s.pid = r.pid
